description: Hard filters and reference bands. Filters exclude; scores rank. The two are kept separate so it is always clear whether a candidate is absent because it was excluded or because it ranked poorly.
currency_note: AUD is the primary displayed currency. JPY is always retained alongside, with the FX rate and its date.
lift_proximity_note: Beyond 15 minutes a candidate is considered only where the investment case is exceptional, and the reason must be recorded on the property.
guest_capacity_note: No capacity is assumed optimal. The economically best size is an output of Phase 17, not an input.

default_hard_filters._comment: Applied during screening unless explicitly relaxed. Deliberately few: over-filtering early would hide exactly the unfashionable markets this project is meant to find.
default_hard_filters.require_identified_management_note: Not a screening filter, because absence of an English-language web presence is not absence of providers. It becomes gating before any recommendation.

disqualification_rules.description: The intended commercial accommodation use cannot be lawfully licensed for this property type in this municipality.
No credible local management provider identified, making remote operation from Australia unviable.

opportunity_signals._comment: Declarative triggers for NEW HIGH-PRIORITY CANDIDATE. Every fired signal is shown to the user; a flag is never opaque.
opportunity_signals.high_capacity_per_dollar_note: Threshold to be set once enough real listings exist to establish a distribution. Set from data, not invented.
